opportunities.name: Pellet Dash Defense
opportunities.objective: Record pellet count, E cooldown and resist stacks during close versus distant shots.
opportunities.mechanic: Each attack bullet hit reduces E cooldown by 0.5 seconds. E reloads one shell, grants armor/MR stacks and doubles stacks when dashing toward a champion. Close contact can connect more pellets; Trinity rewards cast/shot weaving and Death's Dance extends stack maintenance.
opportunities.requiredState: Dash toward a champion and connect pellets without front-unit interception.
opportunities.failure: Spread/missed pellets lose E acceleration; stacks lapse before the next fight.
opportunities.test: Record pellet count, E cooldown and resist stacks during close versus distant shots; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Four pellets do not prove four full item on-hit applications.

opportunities.name: Terrain Return Round
opportunities.objective: Compare wall-triggered Q return reliability with open-space shots.
opportunities.mechanic: Q detonates immediately after terrain collision rather than waiting one second. Shojin supports repeat Q/E and Eclipse rewards separate physical hits; Collector/AD assist finishing while Cleaver supports repeated physical packets. W vision denial helps position the terrain shot.
opportunities.requiredState: Target stays in the return line near terrain.
opportunities.failure: Open-space Q delay is escaped or W's AP magic hit contributes little.
opportunities.test: Compare wall-triggered Q return reliability with open-space shots; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Primary and cone R damage are not both freely assigned to the same target.

ruledOut.reason: P explicitly changes crit into six bullets and a special modifier; ordinary single-projectile crit math is invalid.

unknowns: P level-table raw entries and Stat(9) crit basis need checking; E now lists MR as well as armor, so older armor-only assumptions are rejected.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.

testPlan: Required state: Dash toward a champion and connect pellets without front-unit interception.
Record pellet count, E cooldown and resist stacks during close versus distant shots; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Spread/missed pellets lose E acceleration; stacks lapse before the next fight.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Four pellets do not prove four full item on-hit applications.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Sundered Sky, Black Cleaver, Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
